scoring_notes: Apply each criterion to demonstrated evidence: zero for unsupported assertions; partial credit proportional to valid, relevant findings; full credit requires its entire evidential purpose, not completion of a reference workflow.
Negative, alternative and demonstrated non-identifiable answers can earn full applicable credit; claimed failure or uncertainty alone cannot. Do not renormalize away missing work.
Conditional examples are validity requirements only if that observable or causal claim is made. Source numerical targets are not universal tolerances.
Scientific semantics, alternative-route calibration, blind AR trials and execution isolation remain pending. Synthetic fixture success is not science.
The process axis is the actually loaded shared open_research AR/PR rubric, not an extra package-local rubric.
